title: ConsentDelegationRequest
description: Enables a person to delegate consent to another party.

id.description: The unique ID of this delegation request.

challenge_id.description: The unique ID of this consent request.

household_id.description: The household that this consent delegation is targeted against.

subject_id.description: The person in the household that is requesting consent.

act.description: The delegated person who has approved the consent request.

client_id.description: The client that is targeted for this delegation.

scopes.description: The scopes to apply and access for this client

app_id.description: The application that is targeted for this delegation.

project_id.description: The project that is targetd for this delegation.

org_id.description: The organization that this consent delegation was performed on.

status.description: The status of this consent attribute.

creation_date.description: The date this request was made in UTC time.

approved_date.description: The date that this delegation request was approved.
